components.name: Chart/AI insight
components.description: AI-generated annotation placed on or under a chart. Always marked with the sparkles icon and dataviz/ai/* colours so users can tell model output from data. React: <ChartInsight variant="inline|callout" text />.

Chart/AI insight
An AI-written sentence about the chart, always marked with sparkles and dataviz/ai/* colours. 2 variants.
Overview
What it is and when to reach for it.
Sales dropped 34% on Tuesday
When to use
A model summarised the data or found a cause worth telling.
Inline: one line under the chart. Callout: points at a place in the plot.
Not for static captions written by people — use the subtitle.

Usage
Rules that keep the chart honest and readable.
One insight per chart, max 2 lines.
Finding first, then the reason: “Revenue grew 34% since January; May dipped after the price change.”
State only what the data supports and link to the rows behind it.
Keep the AI mark — users must tell model output from data.
Trust
Pair with Chart/Confidence meter when the model is unsure.
Spec
Library-neutral contract — maps to Recharts, ECharts, D3, Visx, SwiftUI Charts or Compose.

Accessibility
Prefixed for screen readers with “AI insight:”; contrast of text on dataviz/ai/soft ≥ 4.5:1.
